abort.ezviz_cloud_account_missing: EZVIZ cloud account missing. Please reconfigure EZVIZ cloud account

error.invalid_mfa: EZVIZ rejected the verification code. Check the newest code and try again.

confirm.description: Enter RTSP credentials for EZVIZ camera {serial} with IP {ip_address}
confirm.title: Discovered EZVIZ Camera

mfa.description: EZVIZ sent a verification code for {username} by e-mail or SMS. Enter it to finish signing in.
mfa.title: Two-step verification

reauth_confirm.description: Enter credentials to reauthenticate to EZVIZ cloud account
reauth_confirm.title: Authentication expired

abort.no_cameras: This account has no cloud-streamed cameras to set a code for.

data.ffmpeg_arguments: Arguments passed to FFmpeg for cameras

data_description.code: Six capital letters on the camera's label. Leave it empty to remove the stored code.
data_description.serial: Cameras that stream through the EZVIZ cloud, such as battery cameras.

codes.description: Only cameras with video encryption turned on need a code. It decrypts the cloud live stream inside Home Assistant, so it never reaches a browser. Cameras marked ✓ already have one.
codes.title: Verification codes

data.transcode: Re-encode the cloud live stream to H.264

data_description.transcode: Turn it on if the live view of a cloud camera stays black in your browser or in the Home Assistant app. It uses the Home Assistant host's CPU while someone watches.

video.description: Cloud cameras (battery cameras and peepholes) send HEVC (H.265), which many browsers can't play. Re-encoding to H.264 makes the live view play everywhere.
video.title: Video transcoding

set_alarm_detection_sensibility.description: Changes the sensibility level of the motion detection.

level.description: Sensibility level. 1-6 for type 0 (normal camera), or 1-100 for type 3 (PIR sensor camera).
level.name: Level

type_value.description: Detection type. 0 for normal camera, or 3 for PIR sensor camera.
type_value.name: Type

set_alarm_detection_sensibility.name: Set detection sensibility

wake_device.description: Wakes a camera from sleep mode. Especially useful for battery cameras.
wake_device.name: Wake camera
